channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Seattle protesters confront Amazon over ICE contracts and surveillance ties
item.description: Workers, activists, and city officials rally outside the Spheres as Amazon drops Flock partnership but faces mounting pressure to end cloud support for ICE and CBP.

item.title: Senate Democrats demand answers after EPA moves to drop monetized health benefits from air pollution rules
item.description: Lawmakers say Trump administration policy could allow agency to sideline public health gains when weighing industry costs under the Clean Air Act.

item.title: Chemical giant to discontinue production of herbicide with active ingredient in Agent Orange and glyphosate
item.description: Because it contains a mix of an active ingredient in Agent Orange and glyphosate, Enlist Duo is said to be one of the most dangerous herbicides still used on food crops.

item.title: As Democrats demand a tougher fight, new poll elevates AOC and economic populism
item.description: A New Republic and Embold Research survey finds broad unity on taxing the rich, regulating big tech, and a more aggressive posture, with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez leading favorability.
